content: The R. Anjām continues that under the light of the Seal the gardens of wisdom flourished again, and that leading scholars who adhered to the Prophet's example became hosts to wisdom and gave rise to diverse occult sciences. As the cycling of the ages drew ever closer to its centrepoint of sanctified power (nuqṭa-yi valāyat), the edifice built on these sciences grew ever grander; Ibn Turka says these developments are fully compatible with organized, prescriptive religion.
